test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the grammatically correct sentence. **

options.text: The open discussion with the media yesterday on the new policies of the government was an excellent one.
A open discussion on the new policies of the government with the media yesterday was a excellent one.
An open discussion on the new policies of a government with a media yesterday was an excellent one.
The open discussion on a new policies of a government with the media yesterday was an excellent one.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The open discussion with the media yesterday on the new policies of the government was an excellent one.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The sentence has correct subject-verb agreement ("**discussion**" is singular, so "**was**" is the correct verb form).
 
• The article "**the**" is used correctly before "open discussion" because it refers to a specific discussion that took place.
 
• The adjectives "**open**" and "**excellent**" are correctly placed before the nouns they modify.
 
• The preposition "**on**" is correctly used to show the topic of the discussion.

Therefore, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: The article "a" should be "an" before "open discussion" because it begins with a vowel sound.
 
• **Option 3**: The article "a" is repeated unnecessarily before "media".
 
• **Option 4**: The indefinite article "a" is incorrectly used before "new policies" because it refers to specific policies that have already been mentioned.
